critical_code_review_comments:
PremiumShell (src/components/soundmap/premium.tsx L24-63) has an inconsistency: the outer wrapper carries data-testid={rest['data-testid']} while the h1 always carries data-testid='premium-title'. For /scenes both are wired correctly, but any caller passing data-testid to PremiumShell will get it on the outer div — no distinct testid on the eyebrow

(could add 'premium-eyebrow' for future robustness).

PremiumShell L52-56: when a subtitle is provided the muted body uses max-w-xl which is fine, but the fallback L57 renders an empty <div className='mb-10 md:mb-12' /> — dead whitespace. Consider collapsing to a single margin on the wrapping motion.div.

Legacy PageHeader (src/components/soundmap/nav.tsx L349-366) still reads awkwardly: the whisper eyebrow is fed the `title` prop, while the big <h1> is fed `subtitle ?? title` — meaning if only `title` is supplied both the eyebrow and the h1 show the same text. Callers today happen to pass both (e.g. /dsp passes title='DSP' + subtitle=<dspModel>), but callers that only pass title (e.g. /toolkit L31-34 passing only title='Toolkit de RF, potencia y transporte') get 'TOOLKIT' as eyebrow AND 'Toolkit …' as title. Consider clearer prop names (eyebrow/title) or defaulting eyebrow to a slug of the route.

src/pages/room-scan/index.tsx L467-479 is the only page missed by the bulk sed — its custom header (font-bold text-xl) is a functional gap not just typography. Simplest fix: replace lines 469-479 with <PageHeader title={t('room_scan.eyebrow') ?? 'Escaneo'} subtitle={t('room_scan.title')} right={<stepper/>} />.

src/pages/scenes/index.tsx L131-141 hard-codes HUE_SYNC (#5BA777) as the primary 'Cargar' button background. The review request states primary buttons are 'white bg with black text (bg-white text-[#09090b])'. The /scenes Cargar CTA deviates from that primary style (sage-green, not white). It looks great and helps signal 'load into workspace', but it's technically inconsistent with the ProButton primary variant.

The GlassCard component (src/components/soundmap/ui.tsx L15-36) still exposes a `glow` prop that toggles a slightly heavier shadow. Even though the old GLOW_SHADOWS constant was removed, glow=true still yields shadow '0 12px 40px -10px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.06)' — noticeably heavier than the quiet baseline. ActionCard L182 passes glow={active}. Consider removing the glow branch entirely if the new design token is 'always quiet hairline'.

AudioMetricCard L121 still uses 'text-xl font-black' for the value — outside the pages/ scope, but if it renders on any card inside /toolkit or /live it will visually clash with the new quiet aesthetic.

src/store/app.ts persist version=2 — the migration path at L322 was not exercised by my seed (I wrote version=2 directly). If future test agents use version=1 seed data they'll trigger migrate(); confirm migrate() still returns a valid v2 shape.

rca of the issue:
Root cause for the one FAIL: bulk sed replacement targeted class strings (font-black → font-medium, remove font-display) but did NOT transform structural JSX. /room-scan uses a bespoke

inline (line 471) instead of the shared component. The bulk approach used by the main agent to 'upgrade all pages in-place' works for components that import PageHeader — but /room-scan opted out of PageHeader for its stepper-aware header. Fix requires either (a) wrapping the stepper block in a or (b) refactoring the custom header to whisper eyebrow + font-medium big title. Repro: navigate to /room-scan → inspect first

→ font-weight computes to 700 (bold), font-size 20px (text-xl), no preceding uppercase

eyebrow. Compare with /gear-builder → font-weight 500, font-size 38.4px, preceded by 11px uppercase eyebrow.
